name: Shards of Genesis [v0.3.3]
desc:
NOTE: THIS GAME WILL NO LONGER BE UPDATED, BUT WILL BE OPEN FOR THOSE WHO APPRECIATE THE PREVIOUS DEVELOPER(S) CREATIONS!
Version 1.2.6
Welcome to Shards of Genesis, a sandbox class-based fighting game made with passion. 

QUICK TUTORIAL: To equip your weapon in game, press F. To sprint, unequip your weapon and hold left control while not in combat. 
If you have no idea how to use a specific move, click the "Class Info" button at the top right of the class selection menu. It might teach you something new. 
Press T to taunt (If nothing happens, that class has no taunt as of currently). 

Developed by Qaeo, Kyles45678, Exotic_Exhibition, Nylium, Injectioneer, and Tekrinn
